english.title: Improper performance of a relevant function or activity in anticipation/consequence of requesting/agreeing to receive
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) in anticipation or as a consequence of you requesting, agreeing to receive or accepting a bribe, financial or other advantage, a relevant function or activity was performed improperly by you, or by another at your request or with your assent or acquiescence
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 2(1) and (5) and 11 of the Bribery Act 2010.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Prosecution of this offence requires the consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions or the Director of the Serious Fraud Office, section 10.

other.penalty:
Either way -

Summary: maximum 12 months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: maximum 10 years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Notes:
The reference to 12 months is to be read as 6 months in relation to an offence committed before the commencement of paragraph 24(2) of Schedule 22 to the Sentencing Act 2020.

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.

Where any person other than an individual, e.g. a company, is convicted of this offence:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: A fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
